verdict.rationale: Pulley documents a bulk cap-table migration path. It provides an Excel cap table template, treats the uploaded Excel file as the source of truth, and its onboarding team will import Carta reports directly. That covers bulk loading of historical securities, but the evidence does not show that the upload is self-serve rather than team-assisted. missing for 10: evidence of bulk issuance of new grants (e.g., batch option grants), clarity on self-serve versus onboarding-team-run import, ongoing (post-onboarding) bulk upload, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time
